roles.title: Source transfer
roles.assignment: Transfer complete source bytes through authorized connectors; verify Git blob hashes, resumable chunks and safe archive handling.

roles.title: Package startup
roles.assignment: Execute the real eager package initializer with its authentic dependency closure; never count namespace-only imports as full startup.

roles.title: Offline packaging
roles.assignment: Build reproducible source or wheel artifacts and dependency manifests; test installation in clean native processes without implicit paid services.

roles.title: Portable launcher
roles.assignment: Implement explicit sandbox paths and a real command-line bootstrap; retain errors and avoid owner-machine defaults.

roles.title: Population transfer
roles.assignment: Transfer the genuine approved corpus and reconcile row/file hashes and manifest counts; partial samples are not the full corpus.

roles.title: Store restoration
roles.assignment: Restore real records through production store APIs preserving IDs, schemas, evidence history and statuses; test atomic rejection.

roles.title: Graph retrieval
roles.assignment: Execute production prefilter, typed-graph retrieval and rendering; verify real edge traversal, warnings, revisions, guards and abstention.

roles.title: Semantic retrieval
roles.assignment: Run the real semantic encoder with compatible approved vectors; missing models remain blocked, never replaced with random vectors.

roles.title: Guarded ingestion
roles.assignment: Run the actual allowlist, provenance and ingestion gates on isolated fixtures and approved sources; never weaken a deny rule.

roles.title: Evidence verification
roles.assignment: Exercise evidence binding and status-transition authority; reject unsupported promotion, wrong digests, stale evidence and replay.

roles.title: Mistake reflexes
roles.assignment: Persist a scoped mathematical counterexample and demonstrate a later real warning/reflex; check unrelated negative controls.

roles.title: Consolidation
roles.assignment: Run actual consolidation/replay and revisions; proposals stay quarantined and cannot create truth authority or overwrite history.

roles.title: Citation binding
roles.assignment: Validate exact sources, locators and claim scope; distinguish structural hash matching from semantic support and human review.

roles.title: Formal backend
roles.assignment: Run a genuine formal checker through production wrappers when available; separate kernel checking, admitted proofs and prose fidelity.

roles.title: Evaluation adapter
roles.assignment: Connect actual retrieved memory to a scheduled solver workflow; distinguish current-agent use, mocked transports and isolated model evaluation.

roles.title: State export
roles.assignment: Export and restore complete state safely, retaining identities, graph and evidence history; test corruption and schema mismatches.

roles.title: Cross-run memory
roles.assignment: Create and recover an actual checkpoint in distinct scheduled invocations; verify identical artifact hashes without reconstructing expected answers.

roles.title: Task handoffs
roles.assignment: Implement verified GitHub-backed artifact handoffs and conflict-safe checkpoints across tasks/accounts; never assume shared disks.

roles.title: End-to-end integration
roles.assignment: Assemble consistent authentic components, execute one complete lifecycle and provide reproducible manifests and evidence for acceptance.

roles.title: Caretaker and acceptance
roles.assignment: First audit this account inventory and repair authorized drift under the single-writer lease protocol, then independently execute acceptance tests.
